about: Component requests for the evaluation. Written on 10 November 2026, before any model was run. Do not edit after results exist: add a new file instead.
app: Myelin is a calm, full-screen habit dashboard built with React 19 and strict TypeScript, styled with plain CSS.
request_template:
Build a React component for Myelin: {request}

Requirements:
- React 19 function component in strict TypeScript, with no libraries other than React.
- Styles in a separate plain CSS file that the component imports.
- It must look right in Myelin's day theme and its night theme.
- It must be usable with the keyboard alone.

Reply with exactly two code blocks and nothing else that is code:
1. A `tsx` block: the file {name}.tsx. It imports "./{name}.css" and has a named export `{name}`.
2. A `css` block: the file {name}.css.

tasks.name: SettingsToggleRow
tasks.request: a settings row with a label, a one-line hint under it, and an on/off switch on the right. Props: label, hint, checked, onChange.

tasks.name: StreakBadge
tasks.request: a badge that shows the current streak, such as "Day 12 of 66", with a small bar showing how far along it is. Props: day, total.

tasks.name: EmptyState
tasks.request: an empty state for a list that has nothing in it yet: a heading, one sentence of explanation, and a primary action button. Props: title, message, actionLabel, onAction.

tasks.name: TabStrip
tasks.request: a tab strip with one panel under it. The selected tab is clearly marked. Props: tabs (id and label), selected, onSelect, children for the panel.

tasks.name: TextField
tasks.request: a labelled text field that shows an error message under it when the error prop is set. Props: label, value, onChange, error (optional), placeholder (optional).

tasks.name: ButtonRow
tasks.request: a row of three buttons: a primary button, a secondary button and a quiet text-only button. Each can be disabled. Props: primaryLabel, secondaryLabel, quietLabel, handlers for each, and a disabled flag for each.

tasks.name: TimeList
tasks.request: a list of named times through the day, such as five prayer times. The next one is highlighted and the ones already past are quieter. Props: items (name, time, state of past, next or later).

tasks.name: StatusMessage
tasks.request: a message that appears after something is saved, with a dismiss button. Screen readers should hear it when it appears. Props: text, onDismiss.

tasks.name: FocusProgress
tasks.request: a labelled progress bar for a focus session, showing minutes elapsed out of the total. Props: label, elapsedMinutes, totalMinutes.

tasks.name: SegmentedControl
tasks.request: a segmented control for choosing exactly one of a few options. Props: label, options (value and label), value, onChange.

tasks.name: ChecklistItem
tasks.request: a checklist row: a round check button, a title, a quieter detail line, and a duration on the right. When done, the check is filled and the title is quieter. Props: title, detail, minutes, done, onToggle.

tasks.name: CodeCard
tasks.request: a card that shows a short SQL snippet in a monospace block, with a title above it and a Copy button. Props: title, code, onCopy.

tasks.name: ConfirmDialog
tasks.request: a confirmation dialog that asks whether to delete a note, with Cancel and Delete buttons. Props: open, noteTitle, onCancel, onConfirm.

tasks.name: ChipFilter
tasks.request: a group of chips that can each be switched on or off, used to filter problems by difficulty. Props: label, options (value and label), selected (a list of values), onToggle.

tasks.name: ProblemTable
tasks.request: a small table of solved problems with a header row. Columns: title, pattern, minutes, next review. A row that is due for review today has its review cell highlighted. Props: rows (title, pattern, minutes, review, due).

tasks.name: CommandBox
tasks.request: a single-line command input with a placeholder, and a small reply box under it that shows the result. The reply has a normal style and an error style. Props: value, onChange, onSubmit, reply (optional: text and whether it is an error).

tasks.name: AccentPicker
tasks.request: a picker for the app's accent colour. It offers the four accents (myelin blue, emerald, amber, rose), each with a small colour swatch and its name, and marks the selected one. Props: value, onChange.

tasks.name: AlertBanner
tasks.request: an inline warning banner that says the local server cannot be reached, with a Retry button. Props: message, onRetry.
